value.rationale: A minimally frustrated signed cycle is a natural testbed for fractional diffusion and antagonistic consensus. Determining the complete all-time positivity interval for every stable negative strength and every sparse cycle length n>=4 goes beyond PSD tests, eventual positivity, and M-matrix subordination. The exact Chebyshev-integral root, strict monotonicity and sharp endpoint limits provide a structural phase diagram rather than an isolated case or routine computation.
